question: What forms of being are claimed to be potentially attained by this practice?
premises: One may become a divine maiden of the gods.
These are presented as potential attainments.
inference: By this practice one may attain the state of a divine maiden of the gods or of a yakṣa-vidyādhara.
uncertainties: Whether these are literal or subtle states remains open.
plain_english: One may become a divine maiden of the gods, and one may become a yakṣa-vidyādhara.
